description: Kingsgate's shrine under the shelf (plan M6-M9 §5.4): grows the giant to stage 4 once the Kingsgate beacon is relit (world.kingsgate.lit). P29: the same rule as a growth condition (growth_requires_conditions), with its line for the Grow tab.
